title: Covectors on ℝ^P form a finite-dimensional real vector space
statement: For all natural numbers P and n, the real vector space Covector (Euclid P) n = Λⁿ(ℝ^P) is finite-dimensional over ℝ. This is the space of continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin P), with pointwise addition and scalar multiplication.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), FiniteDimensional ℝ (Covector (Euclid P) n)
